name: @ikenga/pkg-meetings
description: Ikenga Meetings app: local recording controls, synchronized transcript player, and meeting intelligence.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && bash sidecars/bot/build.sh && bash mcp/build.sh
scripts.test: node --test --import=tsx src/components/ConsentGate.test.ts src/intelligence/summarizer.test.ts test/e2e-smoke.test.ts test/mcp-transcribe.test.ts test/mcp-transcribe-stt.test.ts mcp/src/whisper.orphan.test.ts mcp/src/openai.test.ts mcp/src/secrets-store.test.ts src/lib/display.test.ts mcp/src/summarize.test.ts
